### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Omit any vital signs or physical exam findings (e.g., BP, Temp, Pulse, RR, specific system exams) not explicitly discussed or recorded in the transcript; do not infer or state them as "not recorded." Strictly differentiate subjective patient reports (e.g., "feels fine," "denies symptoms") from objective physical exam findings; do not list patient denials or feelings as objective observations.
[A-Section]: Limit Assessment entries to problems or habits explicitly identified by the doctor as requiring attention, modification, or intervention. Do not infer issues from reported habits if the doctor does not address them.
